objective: Explore an invented hillside village and leave knowing that its buildings look different because the work inside them is different.
custom_choices: Story constraint chosen before geometry: the villagers collect emberlight, which produced the landmark (a burning hollow stump), the moth loft, the glimmer mill and the lantern motif.
Terrain is a terraced heightfield: a smoothstep quantiser turns a smooth landform into flat treads with short risers near the village, and relaxes to organic hills beyond 38 m.
Buildings are bedded 62% up their footprint's height range so the uphill wall cuts into the terrace and a stone plinth fills the downhill gap.
Fog density and hemisphere fill were re-derived for a 62 m scene; the lighting record's values were tuned for a 20 m subject.
Camera focus on selection approaches from outside the village so framing never lands inside a neighbour's roof.

runtime.render_scheduling: Demand-driven RAF, max 60 fps, hidden-tab suspension, camera/input invalidation; 2048px shadow map fitted to a 42 m extent.

scenes.motion: decorative ambient over discrete state (residents walk a distance along an owned route; the mesh displays it)
entities: The Ember Beacon: 7 m hollow stump, burning crown, keeper's stair (hero)
Seven program-specific buildings: hall, water mill, smithy, granary, moth loft, two cottages
Scale cues: 2.0 m doors, 1.1 m fence posts, 1.5 m fox-folk, 0.45 m benches
Four lanes as terrain-hugging ribbons with stone treads on every riser
Instanced scatter: 96 trees (3 baked value bands, per-instance hue/scale/rotation jitter), 54 rocks, 120 shrubs, 150 shoreline reeds
Moving life: 3 residents on distinct routes, 9 orbiting moths, 5 smoke puffs
actions: select a building by clicking it or by its list button
boundaries: Entirely invented: no historical, structural, ecological or engineering claim.
Dimensions are authored for internal consistency, not measured from anything.
No solver: nothing collides, floats or grinds; the mill wheel does not turn.

physical_contract.scope: Positions in metres; residents advance along a polyline at a stated speed and are projected onto the terrain height.
physical_contract.time: Variable delta capped at 50 ms; authored periods only.
limits: No collision, no contact resolution, no support checks beyond sampling terrain height.
Residents can pass through each other and through props off the lane.

claims_to_visuals.claim: Design claim only: each building's silhouette carries information about its program.

selection_scope: The records guided mood, palette, lighting numbers, the value-grouping discipline, the settlement's functional variation and the selection interaction. Terrain, building geometry, creature rigs and the panel layout are original to this artifact.
